svg.title: Configuration You Can Review
svg.desc: A repository layout showing CLAUDE.md, settings.json, a versioned prompt file, a pinned model id and pinned plugins, where changing any of them goes through review and an eval run.
svg.text: Kestrel Logistics: if a change cannot be diffed, it cannot be reviewed.
Pull request, review, then an eval run
Nothing merges on a green build alone
